title: *EUROPEAN AND EU POLITICS
description: Describes and analyzes the political situation in Europe and the European Union. Special focus is given to issues concerning European security and the European Union, its institutions, politics, and the challenges it faces since the opening of Europe to the East.
books_html: No-cost: Course utilizes open educational resources, materials available through the library, or does not require any purchased materials.
meeting_html: MW 8am-9:50am in MLM 234 - Milam Hall 234 (GP) (9/23 to 12/4)
